performed: Python standard-library controller and harmless throwaway subprocess stages
durable pause after the active stage
fresh-process status and resume from the frozen plan

retained_failed_smoke_receipt.reason: stage timed out while the manual smoke orchestration waited too long before releasing its barrier

coverage.F1: pause and status use frozen state despite changed or missing external plan; resume still refuses changed or missing requested plan
coverage.F2: orphaned harmless child PID, stage, warning, and untrusted output state persist without a false completion receipt; owned child is cleaned up
coverage.F3: an existing-file state root returns structured error code 2 without clobbering content
coverage.F4: unknown top-level and stage keys plus non-finite timeout are rejected
coverage.F5: a pause before launch creates no attempt logs
coverage.F6: matching frozen-only initialization completes once; mismatch is refused

unchanged_invariants: pause persists at the completed-stage boundary and resume skips it
a duplicate driver cannot acquire the run lock
a failed stage retains logs and cannot advance

cleanup.ownership_confirmation: created by the recorded failed manual smoke command; contained one lock byte and no other content

limits: Pause is graceful only after the current stage; it is not an intra-stage checkpoint.
INTERRUPTED does not mean the recorded child stopped; outputs remain uncommitted and untrusted pending manual reconciliation.
The controller does not blindly kill a stale recorded PID or provide full crash recovery.
The shipped plan contains environment checks only; future real training stages require separate implementation and authorization.
